'''Qianqian''' is a female NPC found at Knell Square in {{Location|Lake Heights}}. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Qianqian:''' [[Huaijin]], please be alright...
:{{DIcon}} Who is this Huaijin to you?
:'''Qianqian:''' Huaijin, Huaijin is my... uh, my childhood friend!
:'''Qianqian:''' I haven't heard from him since I last saw him.
:'''Qianqian:''' He said he was going to join the Midnight Rangers, but his name wasn't on the recruit list...
:'''Qianqian:''' And now I can't reach him at all... Did something happen to him?
:{{DIcon}} Don't worry, I'm sure he's fine.
:'''Qianqian:''' Maybe he's fine... Yeah, he's fine, he's fine.
:'''Qianqian:''' I come every day to check. If Huaijin's name's not here, he must be fine.
----
;(After talking to Huaijin)
:'''Qianqian:''' Oh, I wonder if Huaijin is doing okay...
:{{DIcon}} I saw him. He's fine.
:'''Qianqian:''' Really?! Is he okay? Where is he now? Why hasn't he come back?
:{{DIcon}} He's working at the mine. It's... pretty demanding work.
:'''Qianqian:''' Oh, really? That's a relief! He's okay, thank goodness.
:'''Qianqian:''' But how could that boy be so busy with work that he didn't even notice when I called... Doesn't seem like him.
:'''Qianqian:''' Anyway, thanks for telling me!
----
;(Talk to Qianqian again)
:'''Qianqian:''' I need to find Huaijin... I have to see him.
{{Dialogue End}}
